title: 第九章  府内议事
content_zh:
裴昊的声音在客厅中传开，直接是引得气氛瞬间凝固了下来，谁都没想到，这个以往对李洛颇为和善的人，眼下竟是能够说出如此恶毒的话来。
虽说现在的李洛面色的确是惨白，气色不太好，但...也不至于诅咒人没几年可活吧？
裴昊下手的三位阁主，面色略微有些尴尬，不过却没有说什么，只是目光闪烁的盯着地面，犹如脚下地板的花纹格外的吸引人一般。
另外六位阁主，倒是面有怒意。
“砰！”
一声响亮的声音陡然响起，众人一惊，目光看去，便是见到姜青娥玉手拍在桌面上，精致的容颜上，布满寒霜。
不过，还不待姜青娥出声，那裴昊连忙拍了拍嘴，笑道：“对不住对不住，我这嘴，真是太口无遮拦了。”
“还望小洛不要怪罪。”
李洛目光盯着裴昊，他仔仔细细的将后者打量了一下，旋即笑了笑，虽然这几年他也见惯了人前人后的嘴脸，可那些人毕竟是府外之人，而这裴昊，若是说他的爹娘对他有救命，再造之恩，那是绝对不为过的。
没有李太玄，澹台岚的话，裴昊恐怕早就被仇家打断了四肢，丢在了臭水沟中等死，哪还能有今日的风光？
然而，眼下这裴昊所显露的，显然并没有对他爹娘的一丝感激，反而怨恨颇深。
这让得李洛有些感叹，他这爹娘，英明那么多年，还是看错了一次啊。
“裴昊掌事这只是本性流露而已，有什么好怪罪的，而且说实在的，现在我就算是怪罪，又能怎么样呢？所以这种废话，也就不必说了。”李洛摇摇头，然后在那空着的首座上坐了下来。
裴昊面带笑意，他随意的转动着手指上的一枚扳指，倒并没有因为李洛那言语间蕴含的讽刺之意而显露怒气，因为根本没必要，正如李洛所说，就算他想怪罪，那又能怎么样呢？
如今的洛岚府，不是以前了。
没有了那两座大山压着，这洛岚府内，他裴昊，并不惧任何人了。
一个没有什么前途的少府主，不过就是一个傀儡罢了，如果不是还有姜青娥在的话，他裴昊恐怕早就彻底掌控了洛岚府。
“既然少府主到了，那议事也可以开始了吧？”裴昊目光转向姜青娥。
姜青娥面无表情，淡淡的道：“那你就先说说，由你所管辖的三阁中，今年为何一枚天量金都未曾上缴给府库吧。”
裴昊轻叹一声，道：“我那三阁，今年情况极为不好，之前小师妹应该也听过，三阁库房突然被烧，我怀疑是那些觊觎洛岚府的势力捣鬼，也彻查了一番，但却还未曾有结果，所以今年暂时是没有供钱上缴的。”

李洛只是安静的听着，虽然他知晓裴昊的理由滑稽得可笑，但他却没有再继续插话，因为他明白，现在的他在洛岚府中的并没有多重的话语权，所谓的少府主，在府内各方人物看来，或许也只是一个摆着的吉祥物罢了。
既然如此，自然没必要开口自讨没趣。
姜青娥深深的看了裴昊一眼，道：“裴昊，这就是你的理由吗？”
裴昊微微一笑，道：“小师妹既然要理由，那我也只能随便给你找一个了，有些事情，何必要问得明白呢？”
“也罢...既然都已经说到了这一步，那我也和小师妹，少府主都交代一下吧...那三府不仅今年不会再上缴供金，从今往后，也不会再上缴了。”裴昊声音虽轻，可落在客厅众人耳中，却无疑是宛如惊雷。
姜青娥浑身散发出来的冷气，犹如是将空气都要凝滞起来，她声音冰寒的道：“看来你是要打算自立门户了？”
裴昊笑了笑，道：“我可舍不得离开洛岚府...只是如今洛岚府中毕竟没有真正的府主，这些供金交上去也不知道落在了谁的手中，与其如此，还不如等以后有真正令人信服的府主出现了，那我再上交也不迟。”
客厅内气氛压抑，另外六位阁主也是面色有些难看，如果真让得裴昊这么做了，那么洛岚府恐怕将会成为其他四大府口中的笑柄。
因为裴昊此举，已经算是拥兵自重，意图分裂洛岚府了。
“裴昊，你这是想要搞垮洛岚府吗？洛岚府倒了，你以为你能得到多少的好处？”右侧的一名中年男子沉声说道，此人名为雷彰，正是支持姜青娥的一位阁主。
裴昊摇摇头：“我说过，我不想让洛岚府倒。”
他似是沉默了数息，然后目光转向了一言不发的李洛，笑道：“其实要我守规矩，从今往后将供金如实上缴也不是不可以...当然前提是，希望少府主能答应我一个条件。”
客厅内众人皆是一惊，显然没料到裴昊突然将话题扯到了李洛的身上。
李洛从眼观鼻，鼻观心的状态中退了出来，盯着裴昊，似有些好奇的道：“我也想知道，裴昊掌事能有什么条件？”
裴昊视线从李洛的身上，投向了姜青娥，望着后者精致冷冽的容颜以及窈窕的身姿，他的眼眸深处，掠过一丝炽热贪婪之意。
“我希望少府主能够解除与小师妹的婚约。”
这话一出，客厅内的气氛顿时降至冰点。
李洛虽然未曾勃然大怒，但面色倒是变得面无表情了起来，虽说他之前也和姜青娥讨论了退还婚约的事，甚至还与她为此达成了一个约定。
但是...婚约那是他与姜青娥之间的事情，他们两人可以随意的以此来说些什么，做些什么...
而这裴昊，又算个什么东西？

“轰！”
就在李洛心中森寒之意在涌动时，突然有一股强横的能量波动直接于客厅之中爆发。
那股能量，璀璨如光明，光明横扫，遮蔽了客厅的所有光线。
再然后，李洛就隐约的见到，那坐于一旁的姜青娥的身影，宛如一抹惊鸿般暴射而出。
直指裴昊所在。
突如其来的攻击，也是让得裴昊眼神一凝，下一瞬，有锋锐金光于他体内爆发。
他右耳垂上挂着的剑形耳坠迅速脱落而下，迎风暴涨间，便是化为一柄金色长剑。
长剑之上，锋利的金光相力奔涌，吞吐不定，宛如无数金虹一般。
金铁碰撞之声响起，狂暴的能量冲击波爆发，顿时将客厅内的桌椅尽数的震得粉碎。
九位阁主连忙出手，将那能量余波化解，然后定睛看着场中。
只见得那里，两道人影对峙，剑锋相对，正是姜青娥与裴昊。
姜青娥手持一柄重剑，剑身之上流淌着璀璨的光，那光极为的夺目，光是注视间，就让人眼目刺痛。
而且那股精纯的神圣，灼热之感，也令得他们心头一惊。
好霸道的光明相力！
姜青娥对面，裴昊手持金色长剑，那从他体内涌出来的金色相力，则是显得异常锋锐与凌厉。
那是金相之力。
双剑碰撞，相力对冲，引得地板都是在渐渐的龟裂。
裴昊则是双目微眯的笑道：“九品光明相，果真是名不虚传，小师妹明明只是地煞将初期，然而这相力之雄浑霸道，竟是并不逊色于我这地煞将后期多少。”
“你这金相，应该是已升至七品了吧？看来往日没少私吞洛岚府的供金。”姜青娥冷声道。
以前裴昊的金相是六品，可此次交手，姜青娥也察觉到对方的金相之力变得更为的凌厉了，而六品金相想要晋升到七品，其间所需要的灵水奇光可不是小数目。

裴昊不置可否，下一刻，他与姜青娥几乎是同时将体内相力陡然爆发，剑尖狠狠的硬碰了一记。
金铁声裹挟着能量冲击，两人的身影皆是退后了数步。
“裴昊，你放肆！”此时那雷彰等几位阁主也是立即出现在姜青娥身后，面色铁青的喝道。
不过也有三位阁主出现在了裴昊身后，面露戒备。
在客厅之外，这里的动静传出，也是引得老宅中发生了一些混乱，有两波人马如潮水般的自各处冲了出来，然后对峙。
“小师妹，你这是打算让整个大夏国都知道洛岚府发生内乱吗？”裴昊淡笑道。
姜青娥脸色冰冷，美目中杀意流转：“裴昊，如果你不想死的话，先前那种话，还是吞回肚子里面去吧，我们的事，你没资格插嘴。”
裴昊沉默了数息，皱眉道：“小师妹，你何必如此，那份婚约对于你而言，恐怕才是一个累赘负担吧？我知道你对师父师娘感恩，但并没有必要就要委身于李洛，他...真的不配。”
“狼心狗肺的人，当然不懂感恩为何物。”姜青娥淡淡的道。
裴昊摇摇头，然后目光转向了李洛，道：“李洛，你其实挺聪明的，所以我想你应该知道，什么叫做怀璧其罪，洛岚府对你而言，是美璧，小师妹这等天之骄子，对你而言，更是不可触及之物。”
“相信我，如果你想要以小师妹对师父师娘的感恩来禁锢她，那最后只会为你带来一场灾难。”
李洛平静的道：“那依你的意思，是这洛岚府与青娥姐，我都得放弃了？”
“如果你足够聪明的话，就应该如此。”裴昊点点头，有些悲悯的道：“我这也是为了你好，如果没有本事，那就要收敛贪婪，这样还有可能做一个富贵闲人。”
李洛笑了笑，道：“裴昊，你就真的不担心万一哪一天，我爹娘突然又回来了吗？”
裴昊的瞳孔微微一缩，其身后的三位阁主，也是面色有些变幻。
最终，裴昊轻轻摇头，道：“李洛，你就不要抱着这种可悲而幼稚的期望了，从我得来的消息来看，师父师娘，怕是回不来了。”
他看着李洛，面露同情的叹了一口气。
“所以...你最大的靠山，没有了。”
“现在的你，跟当年的我，又有什么区别？不...现在的你，未必就比得上那个时候的我...”
“毕竟那时我虽然没有背景，穷途末路，但最起码，我还有一些潜力。”

“而你...什么都没有了。”
content_en:
Pei Hao's voice spread in the living room, causing the atmosphere to freeze instantly. No one expected that this person who was quite kind to Li Luo in the past could actually say such vicious words now.
Although Li Luo's face is indeed pale and his complexion is not very good now, but...it doesn't mean that he will not be able to live for a few years, right?
The three pavilion masters under Pei Hao looked a little embarrassed, but they didn't say anything. They just stared at the ground with twinkling eyes, as if the pattern on the floor under their feet was particularly attractive.
The other six pavilion masters looked angry.
"Bang!"
A loud voice suddenly sounded, and everyone was startled. Looking around, they saw Jiang Qing'e's jade hands clapped on the table, and her delicate face was covered with frost.
However, before Jiang Qing'e could say anything, Pei Hao quickly clapped his mouth and said with a smile: "I'm sorry, I'm sorry, my mouth is so open-minded."
"I hope Xiao Luo won't blame him."
Li Luo stared at Pei Hao. He looked at the latter carefully and then smiled. Although he had been used to seeing the faces of others in front and behind in the past few years, those people were outside the family after all. And this Pei Hao, if it is said that his parents saved his life and gave him a new life, it is absolutely not an exaggeration.
Without Li Taixuan and Tantai Lan, Pei Hao would have had his limbs broken by his enemies long ago and left him in a smelly ditch to die. How could he be where he is today?
However, what Pei Hao showed now was obviously not a trace of gratitude to his parents, but rather a deep resentment.
This made Li Luo sigh a little, his parents, after so many years of wisdom, still made a mistake once.
"Chief Pei Hao is just showing his true nature. There is nothing to blame. And to be honest, even if I blame him now, what can I do? So there is no need to say such nonsense." Li Luo shook his head and sat down in the empty first seat.
Pei Hao smiled and turned a ring on his finger casually. He did not show anger because of the irony contained in Li Luo's words, because there was no need at all. As Li Luo said, even if he wanted to blame it, what could he do?
Today's Luo Lan Mansion is no longer the same as before.
Without those two mountains pressing down on him, Pei Hao was no longer afraid of anyone in Luo Lan Mansion.
A young palace master with no future is nothing more than a puppet. If Jiang Qing'e hadn't been there, he, Pei Hao, would have completely taken control of Luo Lan Mansion.
"Now that the Young Master is here, can we start the discussion?" Pei Hao turned to Jiang Qing'e.
Jiang Qing'e had no expression on her face and said calmly: "Then first tell me why not a single amount of gold has been handed over to the treasury this year among the three pavilions under your jurisdiction."
Pei Hao sighed softly and said: "The situation in my Three Pavilions is extremely bad this year. Junior Sister must have heard before that the warehouse of Three Pavilions was suddenly burned down. I suspect that it is the forces who covet the Luo Lan Mansion. I have also conducted a thorough investigation, but there is no result yet, so there is no money to hand over this year."
Li Luo just listened quietly. Although he knew that Pei Hao's reason was ridiculous, he did not interrupt anymore because he understood that he did not have much say in Luo Lan Mansion now. The so-called Young Mansion Master may be just a mascot in the eyes of various people in the manor.
In this case, there is no need to open your mouth and ask for trouble.
Jiang Qing'e took a deep look at Pei Hao and said, "Pei Hao, is this your reason?"
Pei Hao smiled slightly and said: "Since little junior sister wants a reason, I can only find one for you. Why do you need to ask clearly about some things?"
"Forget it... Now that we have reached this point, let me explain to my junior sister and the young mansion master... Not only will the three mansions not pay any more contributions this year, but they will also not pay any more from now on."Although Pei Hao's voice was soft, it was undoubtedly like thunder when it fell on the ears of everyone in the living room.
The cold air emanating from Jiang Qing'e's body seemed to freeze the air, and she said in a cold voice: "It seems that you are planning to start your own business? "
Pei Hao smiled and said: "I can't bear to leave Luo Lan Mansion... It's just that there is no real palace master in Luo Lan Mansion now, and I don't know whose hands these donations will fall into. Rather than doing this, it is better to wait until a truly convincing palace master appears in the future, and then it will not be too late for me to hand it over." "
The atmosphere in the living room was depressing, and the other six pavilion masters also looked a little ugly. If Pei Hao was really allowed to do this, then Luo Lan Mansion would probably become the laughing stock of the other four major mansions.
Because Pei Hao's move can be regarded as supporting his own troops and intending to split the Luo Lan Mansion.
"Pei Hao, do you want to bring down the Luo Lan Mansion? Luo Lan's mansion collapsed, how much benefit do you think you can get? "A middle-aged man on the right said in a deep voice. This man's name is Lei Zhang, and he is a pavilion master who supports Jiang Qing'e.
Pei Hao shook his head: "I said, I don't want Luo Lan's house to fall. "
He seemed to be silent for a few breaths, then turned his eyes to Li Luo who said nothing, and said with a smile: "Actually, if you want me to abide by the rules, it is not impossible to faithfully hand over the donation from now on... Of course, the premise is that I hope the young master can agree to me a condition. "
Everyone in the living room was shocked, obviously not expecting Pei Hao to suddenly bring the topic to Li Luo.
Li Luo withdrew from the state of looking at his nose and his mind, stared at Pei Hao, and said with some curiosity: "I also want to know, what are the conditions for Pei Hao to be in charge? "
Pei Hao looked from Li Luo to Jiang Qing'e. Looking at the latter's delicate and cold face and slim figure, a trace of fiery greed flashed through the depths of his eyes.
"I hope that the Young Palace Master can terminate the engagement with the Junior Sister. "
As soon as these words came out, the atmosphere in the living room suddenly dropped to freezing point.
Although Li Luo was not furious, his face became expressionless, even though he had discussed returning the engagement with Jiang Qing'e before, and even reached an agreement with her about this.
But...the engagement is between him and Jiang Qing'e. The two of them can say and do whatever they want based on it...
And who is this Pei Hao?
"Boom! "
Just as the cold feeling was surging in Li Luo's heart, a powerful wave of energy suddenly erupted directly in the living room.
That energy was as bright as light, and the light swept across, blocking out all the light in the living room.
Then, Li Luo vaguely saw the figure of Jiang Qing'e sitting aside, shooting out like a sudden flash of light.
Point directly at Pei Hao's location.
The sudden attack also made Pei Hao's eyes freeze, and in the next moment, sharp golden light erupted from his body.
The sword-shaped earring hanging on his right earlobe quickly fell off and turned into a golden sword as the storm surged.
On the long sword, sharp golden light energy surged, erratically, like countless golden rainbows.
The sound of gold and iron colliding sounded, and a violent energy shock wave erupted, immediately shattering all the tables and chairs in the living room.
The nine pavilion masters quickly took action to resolve the aftermath of the energy, and then looked intently at the field.
I saw two figures facing each other there, their swords facing each other, it was Jiang Qing'e and Pei Hao.
Jiang Qing'e was holding a heavy sword, with a bright light flowing on the sword. The light was so dazzling that it made people's eyes sting just by looking at it.
Moreover, the pure sacredness and burning feeling also shocked them.
What a domineering light power!
Opposite Jiang Qing'e, Pei Hao was holding a golden sword. The golden phase force coming out of his body seemed extremely sharp and powerful.
That is the power of metal.
The two swords collided and clashed with each other, causing the floor to gradually crack.
PeiHao smiled with his eyes slightly narrowed and said: "The ninth-level light phase is truly worthy of its reputation. My junior sister is obviously only in the early stage of the Earthly Evil General, but the power of this phase is so powerful and domineering that it is not inferior to me in the late stage of the Earthly Evil General."
"You must have reached the seventh level of metallography, right? It seems that you have often embezzled money from the Luo Lan Mansion." Jiang Qing'e said coldly.
In the past, Pei Hao's Metal Physics was at the sixth level, but in this fight, Jiang Qing'e also noticed that the opponent's Metal Physics power had become more powerful, and if a sixth-grade Metal Physician wanted to be promoted to the seventh level, the amount of spiritual water and light required was not a small amount.
Pei Hao was noncommittal, and the next moment, he and Jiang Qing'e suddenly exploded with mutual force in their bodies almost at the same time, and the sword tip struck hard.
The sound of gold and iron was accompanied by an energy impact, and both figures took a few steps back.
"Pei Hao, you are so presumptuous!" At this time, Lei Zhang and other pavilion masters immediately appeared behind Jiang Qing'e and shouted with livid faces.
However, three pavilion masters appeared behind Pei Hao, looking wary.
Outside the living room, the commotion here also caused some chaos in the old house. Two waves of people rushed out from everywhere like a tide, and then faced off.
"Junior sister, do you plan to let the entire Daxia Kingdom know that there is civil strife in Luo Lan Mansion?" Pei Hao said with a smile.
Jiang Qing'e's face was cold, and murderous intent flashed in her beautiful eyes: "Pei Hao, if you don't want to die, just swallow those words you said before. You have no right to interfere in our affairs."
Pei Hao was silent for a few breaths and frowned: "Little junior sister, why are you doing this? I'm afraid that engagement is just a burden for you, right? I know you are grateful to your master and your wife, but there is no need to commit yourself to Li Luo. He... really doesn't deserve it."
"Of course a person with a bad heart doesn't understand what gratitude is." Jiang Qing'e said lightly.
Pei Hao shook his head, then turned his eyes to Li Luo and said, "Li Luo, you are actually quite smart, so I think you should know what it means to have a jade in your arms. To you, the Luo Lan Mansion is a beautiful jade, and to you, the pride of heaven, like my junior sister, is even more untouchable."
"Believe me, if you want to imprison your little junior sister based on her gratitude to her master and master, it will only bring you a disaster in the end."
Li Luo said calmly: "What do you mean, do you mean that I have to give up both Luo Lan Mansion and Sister Qing'e?"
"If you are smart enough, you should be like this." Pei Hao nodded and said with some compassion: "I am doing this for your own good. If you don't have the ability, then you have to restrain your greed, so that you can still be a wealthy and idle man."
Li Luo smiled and said, "Pei Hao, are you really not worried that one day my parents will suddenly come back?"
Pei Hao's pupils shrank slightly, and the expressions of the three pavilion masters behind him also changed a little.
In the end, Pei Hao shook his head gently and said, "Li Luo, please stop holding on to such sad and childish expectations. From the news I got, Master and Master, I'm afraid I won't be able to come back."
He looked at Li Luo and sighed sympathetically.
"So...your biggest supporter is gone."
"What's the difference between you now and me back then? No...you now may not be as good as me back then..."
"After all, even though I had no background and was at the end of my rope at that time, at least I still had some potential."
"And you...have nothing."
